title: Eubie Blake still practicing
summary: Eubie, age 96, can't find a piano.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You just told me something concerning that, as you were on your way up here to my room. You ran into the great Eubie Blake in the hall of this Hyatt Hotel.
He's sitting around the lobby fretting, he can't find a piano to practice on.
I feel a little better now. 96 years old and he still has to practice. I don't feel so bad about having to still practice, because I'm only 62.
